---
title: Data Cleaning
format: typst
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- read_csv("data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")
dim(raw_data)  
glimpse(raw_data)  
```

```{r}
has_asterisk <- raw_data |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~. == "***")) |>
  rowSums() > 0
sum(has_asterisk) 

```

```{r}
cleaned_data <- raw_data |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(., "***"))) |>
  mutate(across(TOTREG:last_col(), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(
    FIPS = as.numeric(FIPS),
    CDDIST = as.numeric(CDDIST),
    SDDIST = as.numeric(SDDIST),
    BEDIST = as.numeric(BEDIST),
    ADDIST = as.numeric(ADDIST)
  )

```

```{r}
duplicates <- cleaned_data |>
  group_by(SVPREC_KEY) |>
  filter(n() > 1)
nrow(duplicates)  

cleaned_data |>
  filter(!is.na(TOTREG), !is.na(TOTVOTE), TOTREG > 0) |>
  filter(TOTVOTE > TOTREG * 1.1) |>
  nrow()

cleaned_data |>
  select(TOTVOTE, CNGDEM01, CNGREP01) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(. < 0, na.rm = TRUE)))

```

```{r}
cleaned_data |>
  summarise(
    n_precincts = n(),
    n_counties = n_distinct(COUNTY),
    n_congressional_districts = n_distinct(CDDIST, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_registered = sum(TOTREG, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_votes = sum(TOTVOTE, na.rm = TRUE),
    precincts_with_missing_votes = sum(is.na(TOTVOTE))
  )

```

```{r}
write_csv(cleaned_data, "data/g24_sov_cleaned.csv")
```
